description.value: Railtown Cafe is a Vancouver institution founded in 2012 by award-winning chefs Dan Olson and Tyler Day, offering scratch-made comfort food — gourmet sandwiches, house soups, pastries, and a build-your-own salad bar — prepared daily by classically trained chefs using local and organic ingredients. The Granville Street location is one of three downtown Vancouver outposts tied to the acclaimed Railtown Catering operation. Beer, wine, and spirits round out the locally roasted coffee offerings.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Railtown is an active, multi-location Vancouver cafe with recent news (April 2025), an online ordering system, and three named locations including Granville St. Takeout is confirmed by the 'ORDER NOW' CTA and explicit DoorDash/in-store language; vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options are confirmed directly from the menu text. The OSM phone (+1-604-559-5950) does not appear anywhere on the website — the contact page shows (604) 568 8811 for HQ and (604) 428-0800 for directions — and OSM records the business as 'Railtown' while the website consistently uses 'Railtown Cafe'.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the name as 'Railtown' but the website uses 'Railtown Cafe' consistently throughout.

Phone mismatch: OSM phone +1-604-559-5950 does not appear anywhere on the website; the contact page shows (604) 568 8811 for HQ and (604) 428-0800 for directions. The Granville St. location-specific number is unconfirmed.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, multi-location cafe with confirmed online presence and recent activity; a straightforward Food & Drink stop for touring cyclists in downtown Vancouver.
